div.div: أَطَّاطٌ Sounding much; noisy; (K, TA;) having a sound: applied [to any of the things mentioned above in the explanations of أَطَّ and أَطِيطٌ; and] to a hide; and to a camel repleted with drink; and to a road: fem. with ة: which, applied to a woman, signifies one whose فَرْج has a sound إِذَا جُومِعَتْ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
